name: Barnes Financial Group
address: 11 S New Middletown Rd, Media, PA 19063
hours: Mon to Fri 9 am to 6 pm. Closed Sat and Sun.
description: Barnes Financial Group is a family-run regional accounting and insurance agency in Media, PA, established in 1981, handling accounting, taxes, insurance, and investments under one roof.
tagline: Accounting, taxes, insurance, and investments since 1981

hero.headline: A regional accounting and insurance agency, family run since 1981
hero.sub: Accounting, taxes, insurance, and investments for Delaware County families and businesses, from one office on New Middletown Road.

offerings.heading: Four services, <mark>one relationship.</mark>
items: Accounting and bookkeeping for small businesses
Tax preparation and planning for individuals and businesses
Insurance brokered across carriers, plus investment options
Mon to Fri 9 am to 6 pm
11 S New Middletown Rd, Media, PA 19063

story.heading: Why one office handles all four
paragraphs: Barnes Financial Group was established in 1981 and is still run by the Barnes family, with Richard W. Barnes as president.
One office means the tax return, the insurance renewal, and the investment plan are reviewed by people who have seen all three.

experience.heading: Working with Barnes
items: Call or stop in; weekday hours run until 6 pm.
Bring last year's return and the current policies.
Accounting, taxes, and renewals run on a calendar the office keeps.

feature.heading: Tax season, without the scramble
feature.text: A family-run tax office that also keeps the books means the return is built from records already in order by January.

closing.heading: Accounting, taxes, insurance, and investments since 1981
